rule.title: Linking words: and, but, or, because
rule.explanation:
Para unir dos ideas en una frase usamos conectores.

«And» (y) añade información:
- «I study English and I watch TV.»

«But» (pero) presenta un contraste. Delante suele ir una coma:
- «I like Bristol, but it rains a lot.»

«Or» (o) da opciones. En negativas, «or» sustituye a «and» (ni… ni…):
- «Do you go by bus or on foot?»
- «I don't drink tea or coffee.»

«Because» (porque) da la razón. Para preguntarla usamos «Why…?»:
- «I go by bus because the office is far.»
- «Why do you go by bus? — Because the office is far.»

Ojo: «because» va delante de la razón, no de la consecuencia: «I'm tired because I work at night» (estoy cansada porque trabajo de noche).

rows: I get up at seven and I go to work.
I love my job, but it's far.
I don't walk because the office is far.

I like my flat, ___ it's very small.
Sam plays the guitar ___ he sings.
Priya works at night, ___ she isn't tired.
We go to the park ___ it's sunny.
Is your birthday in May ___ in June?
Javi doesn't study ___ he plays video games all day.
Daniel is Irish, ___ he lives in Bristol.
I go to the gym on Mondays ___ Thursdays.
Why do you study English? — ___ I work in Bristol.
We can walk ___ take the bus.
The café is small, ___ the coffee is great.
I don't go out ___ I'm very tired.
My sister lives in Madrid ___ my brother lives in London.
Do you go to work by car ___ by bike?

items.question: Estoy cansada porque trabajo de noche.
options: I'm tired because I work at night.
I work at night because I'm tired.

items.question: No bebo té ni café.
options: I don't drink tea and coffee.
I don't drink tea or coffee.

items.question: Me gusta Bristol, pero llueve mucho.
options: I like Bristol, but it rains a lot.
I like Bristol, because it rains a lot.

items.question: ¿Por qué vas en autobús?
options: Because do you go by bus?
Why do you go by bus?

items.question: ¿Vino o cerveza?
options: Wine or beer?
Wine and beer?

items.question: Trabajo y estudio.
options: I work and I study.
I work but I study.

items.question: El piso es bonito, pero caro.
options: The flat is nice, and it's expensive.
The flat is nice, but it's expensive.

items.question: Me quedo en casa porque llueve.
options: I stay at home because it's raining.
I stay at home or it's raining.

items.question: Sam toca la guitarra y Priya canta.
options: Sam plays the guitar and Priya sings.
Sam plays the guitar or Priya sings.

items.question: ¿Por qué? — Porque es tarde.
options: Why? — Because it's late.
Why? — Why it's late.

sets.instructions: Une las dos frases con el conector indicado.

items.source: I get up. I have a shower.
answers: I get up and I have a shower
I get up and have a shower
